s: noun
the Bronze Age civilization on the Cyclades islands in the southern Aegean Sea that flourished 3000-1100 BC
تمدن برنزی در جزایر کیکلادز
Archaeologists discovered beautiful marble figurines from the Cyclades civilization dating back thousands of years.
noun
a group of over 200 islands in the southern Aegean
گروهی از بیش از دویست جزیره در جنوب دریای اژه
noun
an interval during which a recurring sequence of events occurs
چرخه، دور
the never-ending cycle of the seasons
noun
a series of poems or songs on the same theme
مجموعهٔ شاعری یا آهنگ با یک موضوع
adjective
recurring in cycles
تکراری، دوره‌ای
The seasons follow a cyclical pattern, returning the same way each year.
noun
a person who rides a bicycle
دوچرخه‌سوار
The cyclist rode her bike through the park every morning.
noun
a picture (or series of pictures) representing a continuous scene
تصویری کامل یا مجموعه تصاویری که یک صحنه پیوسته را نمایش می‌دهد
The museum's cyclorama depicted the entire battle scene in vivid detail.
noun
a solid bounded by a cylindrical surface and two parallel planes (the bases)
استوانه
The can of soda is shaped like a cylinder with flat top and bottom.
noun
a surface generated by rotating a parallel line around a fixed line
سطح استوانه‌ای
adjective
having the form of a cylinder
استوانه‌ای شکل
The cylindrical shape of the paper towel roll makes it easy to hold.
noun
someone who is critical of the motives of others
کسی که انگیزه‌های دیگران را مورد تردید قرار می‌دهد
My cynical friend believes everyone only helps others for selfish reasons.
noun
a member of a group of ancient Greek philosophers who advocated the doctrine that virtue is the only good and that the essence of virtue is self-control
پیرو فلسفه‌ی باستانی یونانی که فضیلت را تنها خیر می‌دانند
adjective
believing the worst of human nature and motives; having a sneering disbelief in e.g. selflessness of others
بدبین، مشکوک به نیات و رفتار دیگران
He's too cynical to believe anyone does anything purely out of kindness.
adverb
with cynicism; in a cynical manner
به طور بدبینانه، با تمسخر و بی‌اعتماد
Larsen's frost-blackened lips curved cynically
noun
a cynical feeling of distrust
بی‌اعتمادی و تردید
Her cynicism about politicians made her reluctant to vote in elections.
noun
(Greek mythology) the virgin goddess of the hunt and the Moon; daughter of Leto and twin sister of Apollo; identified with Roman Diana
سینتیا (الهه شکار و ماه در اساطیر یونانی)
In Greek mythology, Cynthia was the goddess of the hunt and the Moon.
noun
wood of any of various cypress trees especially of the genus Cupressus
چوب درخت سرو
The carpenter chose cypress wood for the outdoor deck because it resists rot.
noun
any of numerous evergreen conifers of the genus Cupressus of north temperate regions having dark scalelike leaves and rounded cones
درخت سرو (گیاه)
noun
a woman who engages in sexual intercourse for money
فاحشه، زن روسپی
The cyprian was arrested during the police raid on the illegal brothel.
noun
a native or inhabitant of Cyprus
ساکن یا بومی قبرس
noun
Greek missionary; the invention of the Cyrillic alphabet is attributed to him (826-869)
سنت کیریل، مبلغ یونانی و مخترع الفبای کیریلیک
Saint Cyril developed the Cyrillic alphabet during his missionary work in Eastern Europe.
noun
Persian prince who was defeated in battle by his brother Artaxerxes II (424-401 BC)
کوروس (شاهزاده پارسی باستان)
Cyrus the Younger led a failed rebellion against his brother Artaxerxes II in 401 BC.
noun
the protoplasm of a cell excluding the nucleus; is full of proteins that control cell metabolism
پروتوپلاسم سلول بدون هسته
The cytoplasm contains many proteins that help control how cells use energy.
